rows.grounds: second-person possessive pronoun referring to the questioner
instrument indicating the means prompting the revelation
locative indicating the textual context of revelation
demonstrative referring back to the previously mentioned knowledge
quantifier indicating completeness of what is revealed
compound past passive participle expressing full manifestation

items.question: By what means has the complete teaching been fully revealed in this tantra?
premises: A question was posed by the interlocutor.
The present tantra serves as the locus of revelation.
The teaching referred to is presented as entirely revealed.
items.inference: Therefore, the interlocutor's question has occasioned the full revelation of that complete teaching in this tantra.
items.plain_english: By your question, all of that has been clearly revealed in this tantra.
